transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I don't know... I guess I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's just coffee... maybe a piece of bread. My pants are hanging loose on me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you want to eat, but find you're just not hungry?
I don't know. I just... don't really care about food right now. I'm not hungry. Like I said, I just... mostly drink coffee. I just don't eat much.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No. I'm not trying to. It's just... happening.
Do you think your weight loss is a good thing?
I don't know. I don't really care if it's good. Like I said... my pants are just falling off me now. It's just what's happening.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No. I don't... I'm not afraid of it. I just don't really care.
Do you think you are underweight?
I don't know. I haven't... I don't really weigh myself or anything. I guess maybe.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained weight back?
I don't... probably not. Like I said, I just don't really care either way. It doesn't matter to me.
Are you afraid of eating?
No. I'm not... it's not that. I just... don't really care about food.
Are you worried about what might happen if you eat a normal amount of food?
No... not really. I just... I don't think about it like that. I'm just not hungry.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess. I used to... I liked going for walks down by the lake. And I had these little model kits I'd work on. But now... I don't know. They just sit there on the table. I just look at them and... it's like they belong to somebody else. I just don't care about them anymore.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

I guess so. I don't really... I don't know about sad. It's just... most days I wake up and there's this heavy feeling. Like an empty feeling right in my chest. Just... feels like there ain't nothing good waiting for me, so... I just wanna keep my head down.
Did you lose interest in things like walking or model kits before or after you started feeling this heavy, empty feeling?
I don't really know... I didn't keep track of it. It just... it all kind of blends together, I guess. I'm not sure which came first.
Do you think you would enjoy walking or working on your model kits if you had the energy to do them?
I don't know. I just... I don't think so. Even if I wasn't so tired, it just... seems pointless. I don't really want to do them anyway.
Do you think you wouldn't enjoy walking or working on your model kits because they wouldn't be fun, or because you're too tired to do them?

I don't think they'd be fun. I just... I used to like walking by the lake, and I liked those little model kits. But now they just sit there. I look at 'em and... it's like they belong to somebody else. Just don't care about 'em anymore.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling?
Um... a while. Maybe... about five months now, I guess. It's just been... hanging over me.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live or hurting yourself?
No. I don't... I don't think about that. Just... tired, that's all.
Have you had any difficulty sleeping?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I'll lie there for hours, staring at the wall. Or I wake up way before the sun and... can't get back to sleep after that. Doesn't really matter, though. Even when I do sleep, I still feel worn out.
Have you had more than two months of feeling this heavy, empty feeling?
I... I already said. About five months. So... yeah, more than two.
Have you had any periods of even a few days where you felt significantly better during these past five months?
No. Just... mostly just been like this. I don't remember feeling better.
Have you had any feelings of worthlessness?

I... yeah, I guess. I mean... I ain't working. Lost that job, so... now my relatives gotta help me out. It just... makes me feel like I'm no good. I just sit around and... replay every mistake in my head. Like I just ruined everything. I don't know.
